# Project OS for Codex

Project OS for Codex is a self-hosted project memory and handoff layer for Codex.

It helps teams make AI work visible, resumable, and easy to hand off:

- Git-backed progress events
- Project kickoff cards
- Next-step tracking
- Handoff packages for humans and AI agents
- Knowledge capture from project retrospectives
- Short-lived, project-scoped AI credentials
- MCP tools for reading project context and appending idempotent progress

Primary documentation:

- README: https://github.com/herry2059/project-os-for-codex/blob/main/README.md
- Codex setup: https://github.com/herry2059/project-os-for-codex/blob/main/docs/CODEX_SETUP.md
- Interfaces: https://github.com/herry2059/project-os-for-codex/blob/main/docs/INTERFACES.md
- Deployment: https://github.com/herry2059/project-os-for-codex/blob/main/docs/DEPLOYMENT.md

Current MCP tools:

- project_os_get_context: read kickoff, acceptance criteria, AGENTS rules, handoff, progress, recent Git trail, and next step.
- project_os_append_progress: append one validated and idempotent progress event plus one Git commit.

Safety:

- Do not ask users for their website password.
- Use a short-lived AI credential bound to one workspace and one project.
- Deletion, member permissions, key management, publication, payment, deployment, and rollback require a human.

This file is a machine-readable documentation index. It is not a claim of affiliation with or endorsement by OpenAI.
